channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Olson: By handing over ICE shooting investigation, Rosen betrays Minnesota
item.description: The U.S. attorney has torched his office’s reputation and failed those seeking a fair investigation into the fatal shooting of Renee Good.

item.title: Vikings’ Kevin O’Connell, Kwesi Adofo-Mensah expect to bring in competition for J.J. McCarthy
item.description: McCarthy, the No. 10 overall pick in the 2024 NFL draft, had a rocky first season as the team’s starter but is still just 22 years old.

item.title: Buzzer-beating three-pointer lifts Wisconsin past Gophers 78-75 in men’s basketball
item.description: After Cade Tyson tied the game for Minnesota with four seconds left, John Blackwell hit the game-winner for the Badgers.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves, playing without Edwards and Gobert, rout Bucks 139-106
item.description: The Wolves led by 31 points at halftime behind 24 points from Julius Randle in Milwaukee. Randle finished with 29.

item.title: Bridge No. 9 reopens to bike and pedestrian traffic on Friday
item.description: The Mississippi River crossing has been closed since April.

item.title: U.S. ending temporary protected status for Somalis
item.description: The order could affect more than 400 Somali people across the state as Trump posts, “FEAR NOT, GREAT PEOPLE OF MINNESOTA, THE DAY OF RECKONING & RETRIBUTION IS COMING!”

item.title: Does Mary Moriarty have a path to prosecute ICE agent?
item.description: The state is pursuing its own investigation after the U.S. Attorney said the FBI would fully take over.

item.title: State appeals federal plan to withhold $2 billion in Medicaid funds
item.description: Federal officials say the state doesn’t have an adequate plan to combat Medicaid fraud, while state leaders call a potential payment pause politically motivated.

item.title: Mass resignation at Minnesota U.S. Attorney’s Office stems from Renee Good shooting, investigation
item.description: At least six attorneys have left the U.S. Attorney’s Office, including Joe Thompson, who took the lead in prosecuting fraud in state government programs.

item.title: Live: Anti-ICE protest outside U hotel grows as tensions remain high in Minneapolis
item.description: Protests continue in the Twin Cities with the lead fraud prosecutor Joe Thompson announcing his resignation from the U.S. Attorney’s Office. Minnesota officials have called for an end to the increased federal presence that has left one woman dead.
